name: Aldiy + Cetatea
description: Aldiy's bonuses (Life Drain, stats and PERCENT_TO_ALL for lords) also apply to Nosferatu and Nosferatu Lords from Cetatea.
author: Kay

russian.name: Альдий + Крепость(Cetatea)
